notes: 2026-03-10: Onsite demo summary — ran retrieval + cross-encoder reranker on 10k-doc subset. AE/SE + Prod Eng attended.
Key ask: enterprise search across 30 years of editorial archives (avg doc length 12k-40k chars), need high recall for longtail queries.
Index scale target: initial 50M chunks (chunk size tradeoff discussed) with plan to expand to ~150M over 12 months.
Latency SLO: 95th percentile end-to-end retrieval+rerank < 700ms for web UI; acceptable background batch queries up to 2s.
Cost sensitivity: target infra cost per live query <$0.10 (including embed + ANN lookup + reranker). Strong interest in quantized reranker and batching to control TCO.
Chunking strategy discussed: variable chunk sizes by content type (transcripts -> 1.5k tokens with 25% overlap; articles -> 800 tokens), maintain section metadata for context-aware rerank.
Sliding-window + hierarchical retrieval suggested: coarse-grain paragraph-level embeddings for candidate selection, then fine-grain chunks for cross-encoder rerank.

Reranker tuning notes: prefer a distilled cross-encoder (fine-tune on internal relevance labels), use hard-negative mining from production logs, and thresholded early-exit logits to reduce average compute.
Caching: strongly recommend prefix/KV cache for repeated queries (episodic news queries) and per-query reranker score cache for top-k candidate reuse.
Model preferences: open to mix of open LLM encoders for embeddings (e.g., sentence-transformer family) + specialized cross-encoder reranker (student model) to meet latency targets.
Evaluation plan: offline holdout with MRR, nDCG@10, latency/cost-per-query estimation. Redwood Optimize suggested to produce batching/quantization suggestions.
POC milestones: (1) Ingest pipeline + chunker (2) Build 10M chunk index + baseline retrieval (3) Add cross-encoder reranker + offline metrics (4) Canary with live traffic 1%.
Security/compliance: need SOC2 Type II evidence, KMS integration for key wrapping, audit logs retention 7 years for legal team. Discussed VPC private control plane option.
